name: p67_battery_class

ownership.argument: Borrowed immutable 36-byte native LvxBattery class, not identity-only. Exact bounded read-copy may construct a module-owned per-instance derived class shim; never write the native flash class or instantiate the shim.
ownership.return_value: No ownership transfer. Native class remains the shim base and the explicitly forwarded native-event class.

provenance.source: Exact .043 read-only native ABI audit of LvxBattery class, constructor, native event, and native destructor walker.

notes: Class offsets base+0, ctor+4, dtor+8, event+12; defaults width62 height32 and packed instance_size104 at+32. Derived RAM shim base must be 0x2cd198dc, ctor/dtor NULL, event module wrapper, remaining fields preserved. Destructor walker 0x1c02917c visits every base: copying native destructor into the shim would double-run it. Restore only live identity-matched instance on detach. Hardware NOT_PROBED.
